input.quote: (viii) it is the rightful owner or licensee of all intellectual property rights to the Service, the Auction Platform and products delivered hereunder;
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no intellectual property / ownership article. The only ownership-adjacent language is Kubient's warranty at p0040 that it owns the IP in the Service, Auction Platform and "products delivered hereunder", AP's warranty at p0043 that it owns the Content and Properties, and the trademark-only provision at p0065 — none of which allocates ownership of AP's Content, Requests or visitor data as between the Parties, assigns deliverables created for AP, or excludes joint ownership. Kubient collects and stores visitor data and receives Requests from AP (p0011, p0035) with no ownership or use limitation, and AP's only licence is a revocable, non-sublicensable platform licence that is revoked on termination (p0002, p0021). There is no assignment of AP IP or data to Kubient, so this is not walk-away territory, but the rule expects an ownership clause and none exists. We have inserted one as General Provisions (j): AP retains all rights in its Content, Properties and data; Kubient keeps its platform and pre-existing tools; deliverables created for AP are assigned to AP with a perpetual, royalty-free licence to embedded Kubient IP; no joint ownership.

proposal.summary: Add an ownership clause confirming AP owns its Content, Properties and data, Kubient owns its platform, and any deliverables created for AP are assigned to AP with a licence back.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement has no ownership provision, so we have added one: we retain all rights in our Content, Properties and data (including Requests and visitor data), Kubient keeps its Service and Auction Platform, and anything created for us is assigned to us with a perpetual royalty-free licence to any embedded Kubient IP. This reflects our standard position that we own what we pay for and what we put in, with no joint ownership.

ops.text: (j) Ownership. As between the Parties, Customer is and shall remain the sole and exclusive owner of all right, title and interest in and to the Content, the Properties, the Inventory, the Requests and all data and visitor information collected from or through the Content, the Properties or the Inventory (collectively, "Customer Data"), together with all intellectual property rights therein. Kubient retains all right, title and interest in and to the Service, the Auction Platform and its other pre-existing intellectual property, tools and know-how. Nothing in this Agreement assigns or transfers to Kubient any Customer intellectual property or Customer Data, and Kubient shall use Customer Data solely as necessary to provide the Services to Customer. To the extent Kubient creates any deliverables, work product or reports specifically for Customer under this Agreement, Kubient hereby assigns to Customer all right, title and interest therein and grants Customer a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to use, modify and sublicense any Kubient intellectual property embedded therein for Customer's business purposes. No joint ownership of any intellectual property is created by this Agreement.
